top.line: Where assist becomes execute: tier agents by reach and undo class, not by autonomy.
top.para: Enforce each tier with a boundary above the agent; our own rule that failed shows why.

in-short.line: The question, capability tiers, four tiers, tightening control, boundaries, our evidence.

question.line: Khwaja Naveed asked how our policies handle the line from summarising to executing in a system of record.
question.para: Yes, tiered, by capability rather than by agent.

capability.line: 23 capabilities in verb.object.reach, each with an undo class: yes, with-effort, no.
capability.para: Assist, own work, system of record, irreversible to the world.

barriers.line: Only a boundary enforced above the grant is a control.
barriers.para: The conductor's rule against pushing to main failed once; branch protection was not set.

patterns.line: Drafts only, plan then apply, and making the dangerous thing unreachable.
patterns.para: Fifty outreach drafts, none sent by an agent.

altitude.line: Tiers are approved once, at the right level.
altitude.para: The approval moves from the action to the policy.

phase.line: Our policies ran in an explorer phase: observe, record, recommend.
phase.para: Lock-down step by step, each with an escape valve.

limits.line: A reading of the grammar; rules by design in explorer phase; counts explained.

sources.line: Khwaja Naveed's comment, abp.sgit.ai and the Web Summit team's policies.
